script:
ROUNDTRIP='import sys, urllib.parse as u; p = u.urlsplit(sys.stdin.read().strip()); q = u.parse_qs(p.query); sys.exit(0 if q.get("folder") == [sys.argv[1]] and not p.fragment else 1)'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/vscode/url" --expect 200 --field url | python3 -c "$ROUNDTRIP" "$WS"
mkdir -p "$F/qa f16&x=1#frag"
ODD=$(control-agent-server conversation start --no-run --tools none --no-autotitle --workspace "$F/qa f16&x=1#frag" --print-id)
OWS=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$ODD" --field workspace.working_dir)
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$ODD/vscode/url" --expect 200 --save F16.vscode-folder-encoding/odd-folder
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$ODD/vscode/url" --expect 200 --field url | python3 -c "$ROUNDTRIP" "$OWS"  # bug
